en-US.name: Rea-Video
en-US.shortDesc: Analyze shots, editing and audio with frame illustrations and slow motion. Install the Rea-Video CLI, Python 3.10+ and FFmpeg separately. The updated CLI requires videomd 1.2+. Optional vision or remake providers require setup and approval before uploads or paid calls.

zh-CN.name: Rea-Video 视频拆解
zh-CN.shortDesc: 逐镜拆解画面、剪辑和声音，输出关键时刻图解与慢放。需另装 Rea-Video CLI、Python 3.10+ 和 FFmpeg（新版 CLI 依赖 videomd 1.2+）；视觉分析与复刻服务另配，上传或计费前需用户确认。
